column1: # title: HCF Audiences v0.2 age bands to PubMed age filters

column9: PubMed filter allinfant[filter] (1-23 months). Ours is 0-2. PubMed's allinfant filter is Infant plus Infant, Newborn (D007231): birth to 23 months.
PubMed filter adolescent[filter] (13-18 years). Ours stops at 17; Adolescent runs to 18.
PubMed filter youngadult[filter] (19-24 years). Ours starts at 18; Young Adult at 19.
PubMed filter adult[filter] (19-44 years). Ours is 25-64, two PubMed bands: Adult (19-44) and Middle Aged (45-64). A search uses both.
PubMed filter middleaged[filter] (45-64 years). The upper half of our Adults band.
PubMed filter aged[filter] (65 years and over). Aged, 80 and over (D000369, aged80) is narrower.
